names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 21 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Γεώργιος επίσκοπος Αμάστριδος», with the rank word and the see left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 21 февраля ст. ст., «Святитель Георгий Амастридский, епископ», with the rank word and the office left off. The line on the day page gives the name in the genitive with the see.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Γεώργιος κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 805 μ.Χ.», and its heading prints «(; - 805)».

feast.note: The calendar's life for him gives the day of his death as «3 марта», which is neither this day nor thirteen days from it: the memory and the day of death are different days here, and the day recorded is the day page's. Read 3 October 2026.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 21 февраля ст. ст. — «Свт. Георгия, еп. Амастридского (802-811).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

feast.note: The row is the day page this folder was read from. Its life page adds «Η μνήμη του Αγίου επαναλαμβάνεται και την 25η Οκτωβρίου» — his memory is repeated on 25 October as well. One attestation row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here. Read 30 September 2026.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Γεώργιος επίσκοπος Αμάστριδος»

attestations.note: Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
